collection.title: BMW X5 2006 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 2006 to 2011 version of a BMW X5 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this X5 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
